title: Correct momentum increment
description: Essential: The final answer for Δp must be 10 kg·m/s (or equivalent).

title: Correct final momentum magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for p' must be 10√2 kg·m/s (or equivalent).

title: Time of flight calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates the time of flight using vertical motion (t = √(2h/g) = 1 s).

title: Vertical velocity change
description: Important: Identifies that the momentum increment Δp is due solely to the vertical change in velocity (Δv_y = gt).

title: Vector composition for final velocity
description: Important: Correctly combines horizontal and vertical velocity components to find the final speed (v = √(v₀² + (gt)²)).

title: Momentum as a vector
description: Optional: Recognizes that momentum is a vector and may discuss the direction of p' (45° below horizontal).

title: Horizontal momentum constant
description: Optional: Notes that horizontal momentum remains constant (no horizontal force).

title: Confusing Δp with final p
description: Pitfall: Mistakenly equates Δp (change in momentum) with the final momentum p'.

title: Ignoring vector nature of Δp
description: Pitfall: Treats Δp as a scalar magnitude instead of a vector change (vertical only).

title: Incorrect time of flight
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect kinematics to find the time of flight (e.g., using horizontal motion).
